The conversation confirmed the current data aggregation versions. The production environment (prod) uses version 8, while staging uses version 7. Participants discussed using `device_session_agg_ml_2` for loading datasets into tasks, noting that this is available in the staging/beta environment but not yet in production.

It was clarified that `device_session_agg_ml_checking` was used only for testing purposes and contained no critical information.
decisions: `device_session_agg_ml_2` can be used in staging/beta environment to load datasets into tasks.
